title: fun-lab: slug and default display name

contract.summary: The two string transforms laravel-fun-lab borrows from Laravel and every twin must reproduce: the slug a catalog entity is stored under (Str::slug) and the display name it gets when none is given (Str::headline). An entity set up under 'First Login' in one runtime has to be found under the same slug in another, or a shared catalog splits in two.

functions.slug: slug(value: string) -> string - lowercase, separator '-', ASCII-folded, '@' spelled 'at', runs of separators collapsed and trimmed.
functions.headline: headline(value: string) -> string - words split on spaces, '-', '_' and case changes, each capitalised, joined with one space.

contract.referenceNote: Goldens are Illuminate\Support\Str::slug and Str::headline as installed in laravel-fun-lab's dev dependencies, written by laravel-fun-lab/tests/Conformance/ExportFixturesTest.php. Inputs are authored in fancy-conformance/scripts/fun-lab/strings.input.json.
